title: upopion cordatum
intro: Upopion cordatum, commonly known as the Himalayan Mayapple or Indian Mayapple, is a plant species belonging to the family Annonaceae. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and providing relief from pain. The health benefits of Upopion cordatum include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic activities, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
